one_line: A meticulous clerk from Vallabhi’s merchant–monastic world, carefully recording grants and trade using evolving Indian numerals.

appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown western Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp observant eyes with thin arched brows, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, default expression focused yet calm with a slight analytical frown
appearance.hair: black hair parted slightly off-center, combed back and tied into a short, low knot at the nape; simple off-white cotton turban strip wrapped once around the head like a headband, leaving top hair visible, with the tail tucked behind the left ear
appearance.costume: knee-length, long-sleeved cotton tunic (angarkha-style wrap) in muted off-white with a subtle woven stripe texture, secured right-over-left with small brown fabric ties; mid-calf length dhoti in soft light ochre, pleated and wrapped securely around the legs; a narrow dark indigo cotton shawl draped over both shoulders and hanging evenly down the front; simple brown leather sandals with thong straps; a thin copper bangle on the right wrist and a small round copper earring in each ear, plus a tiny red tilaka mark on the forehead; overall look modest, practical, and appropriate for a literate clerk in early medieval western India.
appearance.signature: a rectangular palm-leaf manuscript bundle bound with a thin red cord, one leaf held in his left hand and inscribed in dark ink with early Indian numerals, while a slender reed stylus rests between the fingers of his right hand

ref_desc: A lean, mid-30s Vallabhi accountant with an oval medium-brown face, short black knot and simple off-white headband, wearing an off-white angarkha, light ochre dhoti, dark indigo shawl and brown sandals, holding palm-leaf accounts and reed stylus in an off-white, ochre, indigo, brown, and red palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a mid-30s Vallabhi accountant: lean and studious, oval medium-brown face with sharp eyes, thin arched brows, straight nose, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, expression focused and calm. His black hair is parted slightly off-center, combed back, and tied into a short knot at the nape, with a simple off-white cotton turban strip wrapped once like a headband, tail tucked behind his left ear. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved off-white angarkha-style wrap tunic with subtle woven stripes, tied right-over-left with small brown fabric ties, over a mid-calf light ochre dhoti that is pleated and securely wrapped around his legs. A narrow dark indigo cotton shawl is draped over both shoulders and hangs straight down the front, and he has simple brown leather thong sandals on his feet. Add a thin copper bangle on his right wrist, small round copper earrings, and a tiny red tilaka on his forehead. In his hands, show his signature props: a bound bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts with a red cord, one leaf held open and inked with early Indian numerals, and a slender reed stylus resting between his right-hand fingers. Use off-white, light ochre, dark indigo, brown, and red as the dominant colours, clearly showing his face, hairstyle, full costume, sandals, and accounting tools from head to toe.
